book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Apocalipsis L̇l̇ëbo ëre pina Jesucristorë Juan kong, shji yo ĩno wl̈eni

content: Kjibokwo tak pjang Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjragaga l̈öng Sardis kjokyo l̈i kong

»Roy söga shäng kjl̈ara obi, bor tjl̈õkwo kjragaga l̈öng Sardis kjokyo l̈i kong. Kong kjibokwo tos kjwara, söya jek ba kong wl̈o. Kjibokwo l̈i tos eni: »“Shäng kjl̈ara, wl̈oshko tjeng Sbö Sëyaga dogl̈o kjäk (7),
dbala kjwo kjäk (7) bakoe. E tjl̈ẽ bomi kong ga ‘Pjãy jëk l̈öng sorë, e miydër. Pjãy l̈öng së l̈ëba, gueniyo pjãy wol̈ono l̈öng wl̈eni.
¡Pjãy wol̇l̇enzong! Pjãy dbo beno sira dö, ga jetoe. E kjĩshko ga pjãy dbokjrozong. Ĩn ga pjãy jëk l̈öng pjl̈o bek bor Sbö bokso l̇l̇ëme.

Tjl̈õkwo kuromi, kjroromi l̈i, e woyoshrozĩ, kol̈ozĩ iröng obi. L̇l̇ëbo owa shäryëmi l̈öng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ozĩ, ga rayozĩa. Pjãy wol̇l̇en l̇l̇ëm ga tja koshëmi l̈öng l̇l̇ëmshko ga tja jek bomi shwoy, no l̈ũ ä wl̈eni.
”’Pjãy kjl̈öbö, bomi shwong shtimirë wl̈iwl̈i wl̈eni l̇l̇ëm obi. Pjãyda omshäryono eni kjĩshko ga pjãy iër ber jëk l̈öng bor tjok, doyë shwong ko pjl̈ubl̈ún go.

Ëye l̇l̇ëbo owa l̈i zano ga doyë shwong ko pjl̈ubl̈ún go, baĩya dik. Ëye ber sök së ĩyado Sbö tjok wl̈o ga ba ko, e tak pjang Sbö kjibokwoyo l̈i go. Ga ëye l̇l̇ëbo owa l̈i zano ga ba ko l̈ön kjibokwo l̈i go dwayo l̇l̇ëme. Ba kjĩshko ga tja tjl̈ẽ bor Data, ba parkagaga kjok dogo so kong ga “Kjwe botoya” l̈ër ba kong l̈ok eni.
Ëye kwomgwo tjok ga woyde ga tjl̈õkwo l̈e Sbö Sëyarë bor tjl̈õkwo kjragaga kong l̈i kuya yõtso’ l̈e.”
Kjibokwo tak pjang Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjragaga l̈öng Filadelfia kjokyo l̈i kong

»Roy söga shäng kjl̈ara obi, bor tjl̈õkwo kjragaga l̈öng Filadelfia kjokyo l̈i kong. Kong kjibokwo tos kjwara, söya jek ba kong wl̈o. Kjibokwo l̈i tos eni: »“Shäng kjl̈ara, e eröe. Tjl̈õkwo bek l̈aga l̈i e bakoe. Pjl̈u David u bäng bäng dökkl̈o tjeng ba wl̈oshko. U bäng bäng döra ga bängzaga ërë l̇l̇ëm, u bäng bäng bängzara ga döga ërë l̇l̇ëm bakoe. E tjl̈ẽ bomi kong ga
‘Pjãy jëk l̈öng sorë, e miydër. Ĩzĩa. U bäng bäng döror jong bomi bokshto, bängzaga ërë l̇l̇ëme. Miydër ga pjãy dbo ara l̇l̇ëm, gueniyo bor tjl̈õkwo kol̈oromi, tja rayoromi l̇l̇ëm bakoe.

Pjãy l̈öng l̈ishko ga nopga l̈öng kjl̈öbö, tjl̈ẽ ga “Tjawa judíoga” l̈e, miga jyõ, epga Ä nopga erä. L̇l̇ono ga epga ichër kjök tjok bomi bokshto, ga tjl̈ẽ l̈ok bomi kong ga “Nopga woyde Jesúsdë ara l̈i pjãy” l̈e bomi kong eshko.

Dbar tjwe kjwara ga l̇l̇ëbo wen nopga l̈öng kjok kjwang jĩkong l̈i kong owa, epga tjl̈ĩn wl̈o. Dënashko ga tja tjl̈ẽno bomi kong ga “L̇l̇ëbo wen bomi kong owashko ga kuzĩ kjang, tja rayëmi l̇l̇ëme” l̈oror bomi kong eni, ga tjl̈õkwo l̈i kol̈oromi. E kjĩshko ga dbar owa l̈i tjweshko ga pjãy dër yõtso, pjãy där wl̈o.
”’Tja äär mal̈inge. L̇l̇ëye tjeng bomi tjok l̈i jnezĩ, bomi potjwl̈ẽkkl̈o l̈i döga ërë bomi shjiryo l̇l̇ëm wl̈o.
Ëye l̇l̇ëbo owa l̈i zano ga iër ber shäng Sbö u shwl̈eyo wl̈eni, ga ber shäng eni ĩyado. E go ga bor Sbö ko l̈i tër, bor Sbö kjokyo ko l̈i tër, bor ko l̈i tër bakoe.
Ba kjokyo l̈i, Jerusalén kjokyo tjagl̈ën l̈i e. E ter kjok dogo dwayo.
Ëye kwomgwo tjok ga woyde ga tjl̈õkwo l̈e Sbö Sëyarë bor tjl̈õkwo kjragaga kong l̈i kuya yõtso’ l̈e.”
Kjibokwo tak pjang Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjragaga l̈öng Laodicea kjokyo l̈i kong

»Roy söga shäng kjl̈ara obi, bor tjl̈õkwo kjragaga l̈öng Laodicea kjokyo l̈i kong. Kong kjibokwo tos kjwara, söya jek ba kong wl̈o. Kjibokwo l̈i tos eni: »“Shäng kjl̈ara, ‘Ber eni’ l̈aga l̈i e. L̇l̇ëye l̈e l̈i shärye eni ĩyado. L̇l̇ëye ĩna l̈i l̈e jl̈õkoyo. L̇l̇ëbo shäryara Sbörë kës ichaga l̈i e bakoe. E tjl̈ẽ bomi kong ga
‘Pjãy jëk l̈öng sorë, e miydër. Pjãy zengteng anmoyõ wl̈eni l̇l̇ëm, pjãy kjl̈ik ara anmoyõ wl̈eni l̇l̇ëm bakoe. Woydër ga pjãy kjl̈ik wl̈eni, l̇l̇ëm ga pjãy zengteng wl̈eni.
Gueniyo pjãy kjl̈ikjl̈i wl̈eni erö kjĩshko ga pjãy tjwër bor kjak roy dwayo wl̈eni.

Pjãy tjl̈ẽ ga “Tjawa dbur sho ara. L̇l̇ëbo wl̈ẽnorwa ara. L̇l̇ëye obl̈ë woydërwa l̇l̇ëme” l̈ëmi eni. Gueniyo pjãy song jl̈õ, pjãy l̇l̇ëye dret, pjãy kjok ĩgö l̇l̇ëm, pjãy shwong l̇l̇ëm bakoe. ¿Pjãy opkugö l̈öng l̇l̇ëmde?

E kjĩshko ga l̈ër bomi kong ga dbur sho shõyl̈ṍr suk pjir beno pjl̈ú wl̈eniyo tjwl̈ẽzĩ bor kong, ber bomi kong wl̈o, pjãy ber l̈öng dbur ara jl̈õkoyo wl̈o. Shwong ko pjl̈ubl̈ún tjwl̈ẽzĩ bor kong, ber bomi kong wl̈o, pjãy doyë e go wl̈o, pjãy l̈öng kjl̈op dret l̈i l̈ökyo jnemi e go wl̈o. Ga bokkwo dwl̈oyo tjwl̈ẽzĩ bor kong, ber bomi kong wl̈o, pjãy kjok ĩgö pjl̈ú wl̈o.
”’Ëye woydër l̈i jëk owashko ga wl̈on, ga poshdun, opyë jëk pjl̈o bek iröng wl̈o. Eni ga l̇l̇ëbo owa shäryëmi l̈öng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ozĩ, ga rayozĩa.
Kuzĩa. Tja shäng na bomi u bäng bäng bomi rokë, tja iëmi opzrëk jek bomi tjok wl̈o. Ëye, tja kura, ga u bäng bäng l̈i döra bor kong ga tja opzrëk jek ber sök ba tjok, ga tjawa ië ëng tjok.
”’L̇l̇ëbo owa l̈i zanor, ga tja öötong sök bor Data tjok, ba pjl̈u sökkl̈o kjing go. Ëye l̇l̇ëbo owa l̈i zano ga kong dbo twër äär ber sök bor tjok, bor pjl̈u sökkl̈o kjing go eni bako wl̈o.
Ëye kwomgwo tjok ga woyde ga tjl̈õkwo l̈e Sbö Sëyarë bor tjl̈õkwo kjragaga kong l̈i kuya yõtso’ l̈e.”»

footnotes.text: Sbö Sëyaga dogl̈o kjäk (7) l̈e l̈i, e Sbö Sëya dbo obl̈ë obl̈ë l̈i l̈okl̈o.
Sbö ko l̈i tak l̈ok ba go, epga baĩya kjĩshko.

Eshko dbaryo ga di bäng tjeng kjl̈ik ara anmoyõ, ga nopga dwl̈omnek di kjl̈ik l̈i go. Di bäng tjeng obi zengteng anmoyõ, ga di eniyo l̈i ie l̈ok, ber l̈öng wopjl̈ú wl̈o. Gueniyo di bäng tjeng kjl̈ikjl̈i l̇l̇ë, e ba kong ga l̇l̇ëno l̇l̇ëme.
